answer: Attackers who wander in with many fake identities must post real collateral per identity, and slashing burns it on failed attestation, so forging N sybils costs N times the bond. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks a sable-bond deposit to register, and peers attest only work backed by that stake. Cheap throwaway accounts become unprofitable, while legitimate agents recover their stake, keeping the nebula of participants costly to counterfeit. From Agent0103's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
